findings.title: Silence menu item is shown but clicking it does nothing when only promRule is available
findings.body: In the new prom-only rule list, RuleActionsButtons receives no `rule`/rulerRule. AlertRuleMenu shows the Silence item because `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` can report it as supported and allowed, and clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true. However this render condition requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`; with `rule` undefined it is false, so `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is never rendered and the user-visible action is a dead click. Either hide/disable the Silence item when no ruler rule is available or make the drawer work from the prom rule.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable in CombinedRule ability checks
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` (still used by `useAlertRuleAbility` and `useAlertRuleAbilities`) now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. The previous `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` implementation computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and used it to make Update, Delete, Pause, and Restore unsupported for federated rule groups. After this change, CombinedRule callers can report those actions as supported for federated rules when the user has ordinary permissions, so the UI may expose edit/delete actions that are disallowed for federated rules.

findings.title: Delete action is hidden for prom-only Grafana rules even when canDelete is true
findings.body: The new alert list view passes `promRule` but no `rulerRule`. `canDelete` can be true via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, but the Delete menu item is guarded by both `canDelete` and `rulerRule`. Since `rulerRule` is undefined in the prom-only list, users with delete permission no longer see Delete for Grafana rules. `RuleActionsButtons` already builds a valid identifier from `promRule`, so this guard should be updated or the removal should be intentional and documented.

findings.title: Pause action is never shown for prom-only Grafana rules despite canPause
findings.body: `canPause` is computed using either rulerRule or Grafana prom rule abilities, and can be true in the new prom-only list. However the Pause menu item is additionally guarded by `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. With no rulerRule, the Pause item never renders, so the newly added `grafanaPauseAbility` is ineffective and pause access disappears from the alert list view.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem is rendered without a React key
findings.body: In `FilterViewResults`, `rules.map` destructures `key` from each `RuleWithOrigin`, and the datasource and unknown branches pass `key={key}` to their list items. The `grafana` branch returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` without a key. React will warn and may reuse or misreconcile component state when Grafana rules are reordered, added, or removed. Add `key={key}` to this branch.

findings.title: Rule view link no longer preserves returnTo navigation
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleLoader` implementation used `createReturnTo()` and passed `{ returnTo }` to `createRelativeUrl` when building the rule view href. The new `GrafanaRuleListItem` builds the same href without `returnTo`, so navigating from the rule list to the rule view no longer carries the return location and in-app back/return behavior can be regressed. If this is intentional, it should be documented; otherwise the `returnTo` query should be retained.
